name: Halo imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes, one of the Magma King's: leathery skin, short curled horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, gold-tinted skin, a ring of glowing embers circling its head

poses.stand: hovering mid-air on spread bat wings, both arms held out wide, a ring of ten small glowing embers floating round its head like a halo
poses.struck: just hit and caught mid-shriek: eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, wings snapped up, body tilted back with cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: bursting apart in a small round pop of black soot and bright orange embers, only its horns tumbling out of the puff

idle.action: hovers, flapping its wings, the ring of embers circling slowly round its head

attack.action: throws both arms wide and the ring of embers bursts outward all at once, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: shrieks, swells with orange light shining through the cracks in its skin, and pops like a firecracker into a puff of black soot and embers
